benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (with cost per task)
benchmarks.what_it_measures: A combined score of many independent tests of reasoning, knowledge, coding and agent work, run by a third party; the page also lists a Cost per Task in USD (page gives no definition or index version/date, models shown at max/xhigh effort).

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.1
benchmarks.what_it_measures: How often an AI agent finishes real command-line tasks correctly; the 'cost' column is the total dollars for the whole benchmark run, not per task.

benchmarks.name: Agents' Last Exam v1.1 (Snorkel AI)
benchmarks.what_it_measures: How often an AI agent fully completes 122 realistic professional-job tasks across 55 sub-industries; the page shows runtime and output tokens but NO dollar cost.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.notes: Max effort. ALE harness Claude Code, 177h runtime, 21.5M output tokens. Terminal-Bench cost is rounded ($4.7k) whole-run total. OpenAI chart as reported by a secondary outlet (unverified) shows Opus 5.5 63.2% at $8.82/task.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.notes: ale_v1_1: not listed on Snorkel leaderboard.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.2
models.notes: Max effort. ALE result excludes 9 downgraded tasks (averaged over the rest), 227h runtime, 28.2M output tokens. Highest AA index of the 12.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.notes: Price is for prompts up to 100k tokens; over 100k is $0.50 in / $2.50 out. ale_v1_1: not listed.

models.name: GPT-6.2 Sol
models.notes: Standard tier, prompts up to 272K tokens. Batch is half price. ALE harness Codex, 31h40m, 3.1M output tokens.

models.name: GPT-6.2 Astra
models.notes: Rank 1 on ALE v1.1 (Codex, 29h7m, 2.6M output tokens; page lists several effort levels without saying which was scored). Standard tier, prompts up to 272K; batch is half price.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.notes: ale_v1_1: GPT-6 Luna not listed (only GPT-5.6 Luna, 5.7% pass, which is a different model, not used).

models.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.notes: Standard tier, prompts up to 272K tokens. ALE harness Codex, 124h36m, 5.5M output tokens. A secondary outlet (unverified) reports an OpenAI chart of Terra 60.0% at $1.01/task.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.notes: Price is for prompts under 200k tokens; 200k+ is $4 in / $12 out. AA ran it at xhigh effort. ale_v1_1: not listed.

models.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
models.notes: Price is from third-party aggregators (several agree: $2 in / $10 out, $0.20 cached); Moonshot's own pricing page tables did not load (https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat). Snorkel lists it as 'Kimi 3.1 Pro', Kimi Code harness, 61h26m, 8.5M output tokens.

models.name: Kimi K2.8 Preview
models.notes: No benchmark data: not listed on Artificial Analysis, Terminal-Bench or Snorkel ALE. Price is a reseller rate (LLM Gateway / Tencent Cloud), no official Moonshot price found. Moonshot says K2 models close to new users Oct 31 2026 and retire by end of Dec 2026 (https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat).

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.notes: Price is the peak rate; off-peak (half) is $0.66 in / $1.98 out. Both leaderboards list the 0813 snapshot. Snorkel lists only 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017)', a different model, not used.

ale_context.note: Agents' Last Exam v1.1 on Snorkel (checked 2026-11-19) lists GPT-6.2 Astra 47.5% pass / 78.3% score, Fable 5.2 46.9/72.8, Gemini 4 Carbon 45.9/77.4, Opus 5.5 43.4/71.6, GPT-6 Astra 42.6/73.1, GPT-6.2 Sol 41.8/72.5. The page has no dollar cost column. OpenAI's own score-vs-cost chart data was not found on a primary source; a secondary outlet's cost-per-task numbers (Opus 5.5 $8.82, Terra $1.01, GPT-6 Astra $7.24) are unverified.

caveats: AA 'Cost per Task' has no definition on the page; its numbers are not consistent with token prices (e.g. Sonnet 5.5 $10.02 vs Opus 5.5 $10.04), likely reflecting token usage at max effort.
Terminal-Bench cost is rounded to $0.1k for the whole benchmark run.
Terminal-Bench 4.1 page gives no evaluation date; AA page gives no index version/date.
